The `occt-cube.step` acceptance fixture is the unmodified simple cube from the
official occt-import-js repository:

- https://github.com/kovacsv/occt-import-js/blob/main/test/testfiles/simple-basic-cube/cube.stp
- Upstream attribution: https://grabcad.com/library/simple-basic-cube

Downloaded 2026-09-26. The fixture is a 300 mm cube and is used only to verify
OpenCascade STEP tessellation, length units, and watertight output.

Implementation API reference: https://github.com/kovacsv/occt-import-js#how-to-use
The runtime dependency is the upstream `occt-import-js` npm package (LGPL-2.1).
